0.content:
Dahlia's first meeting with Venti came in a tavern: seeing a bard alone among empty bottles, he assumed a frustrated artist and kept him company. After the bard's twenty-eighth cider, it turned out he was simply celebrating a sweet harvest. Dahlia paid for round after round, and they became firm friends. Later, on the city walls, Venti asked why he had fled the Church's offer, and suggested a way to make rituals interesting: relay the Anemo Archon's guidance. That night Dahlia became the keeper of Barbatos's secret and his herald. Dahlia passes Venti the nation's news and announces his answers at morning prayers. Venti says a god needs someone to voice his will formally, and no one does it better.

Dahlia jokes that the trick to becoming the Archon's favourite is knowing Mondstadt's taverns and buying a certain customer drinks regularly. He says Barbatos convinced him keeping the secret would be the more fun choice. He handles things Venti cannot attend to personally, and negotiates month-long all-you-can-drink deals for him (with Kaeya's haggling). Venti uses him as an intermediary because he loves listening to the wind "but crucially he has his own compass, too".

At Starsnatch Cliff (5.6) Dahlia teased Venti about the drunken musings of their three tavern trips last month, which he had yet to decipher, and told him his belief in the Anemo Archon was never blind. Venti promptly asked him to forget Barbatos and buy a drink. Dahlia once "accidentally" lost a game of Genius Invokation TCG to him and paid up in drinks. Venti once wrote down an "Ode to Fine Wine" for him, born of a toast to Barbatos.

1.comment: Dahlia: The Oracle and the Deaconship
1.content:
After his night with Venti, Dahlia returned to the Church claiming to be an oracle bearing Barbatos's words. Many sisters feared a charlatan; others argued that ignoring a true prophecy could do real harm. The second view won, and Sister Victoria proclaimed his words at morning prayers. Rain followed his call to plant, a fierce storm came on the day he warned boats to stay ashore, and hunters doubled their catch on the day he named. The Church offered him the post of deacon. His first morning prayers packed the Cathedral.

Since then, when Mondstadt faces hardship, Victoria invites him to lead morning prayers because Barbatos always seems to answer him. Popular theories credit his noble character, his wine-sweet singing or some secret divination. Asked himself, he winks and says the gods let him help because he enjoys meddling.

2.comment: Dahlia: The Scripture and the Hydro Vision
2.content:
Some people Dahlia had once "snooped" on came to Cathedral prayers to humiliate him. One heckler demanded where in scripture his words were written. Dahlia answered calmly that the wind cannot be held, yet some try to trap it in a book. The heckler left defeated. At home Dahlia read the stone-heavy scripture word by word until he knew it by heart. Nobody had asked him to. He knew the book was mostly Mondstadt's history and praise, not Barbatos's own words, but he was a deacon now and his conduct represented the Church. At his next prayers his manner was solemn and his speech poetic; Victoria wondered if Barbatos had coached him. He had found his Vision lying on the scripture like a bookmark.

He had always assumed he would get an Anemo Vision and jokes that Barbatos must not see him as a lost soul needing constant attention. What he left unsaid to Victoria was that he had changed for others' sake and now wanted to use his power to guide the world somewhere brighter.

3.content:
Dahlia's first brush with the Church was doing Rosaria's turn at answering letters while she was away on an investigation. She came back stained with what might have been blood and relayed Victoria's offer of a job; he fled. Now they are very close friends. She was closed-off at first, but he found a way to catch her every time she went missing, and they struck a mutually beneficial agreement. Rosaria likes that he always offers to pay, knows which questions to avoid, and is smart enough that she no longer needs to be guarded with him.

Barbara has been sent by "Deacon Dahlia" to drag Rosaria to choir practice. Dahlia wrote a birthday letter, at Victoria's request, urging her to be a normal sister for once. In 6.5 the two of them slipped away from chores for a drink (Rosaria drank double; he took juice), then came back and finished wiping the windows Barbara had started.

4.content:
Barbara is a fellow member of the clergy and a friend. Dahlia calls turning her into an idol a genius marketing move for the Church, whether or not she or Alice intended it. He likes involving her in everything, reasoning that she is happiest helping people. She looks up to him for sharing Barbatos's word, but thinks he never stays at the Cathedral long.

He told Barbara that Venti is Barbatos. She did not believe him and threatened to make him weed the Cathedral's front lawn if he repeated it. He keeps up the "lie" as a running joke, and confessed it to the Cardinal in 6.5. He declined to become an idol himself, finding it far more satisfying to watch Barbara meet people's expectations.

5.content:
Kaeya met Dahlia by losing a drinking contest to him and calls his tolerance "through the steeple". They are now top drinking buddies. Kaeya haggles tavern deals for Venti on Dahlia's behalf and collects free drinks for it. Diluc is the one owner Kaeya cannot talk down, so Dahlia never gets a discount at Angel's Share.

Jean disapproves of Dahlia settling citizens' disputes by hauling both parties to the tavern for a drinking contest. Dahlia argues that a deacon who refused Mondstadt's wine, the Anemo Archon's gift, would be the truly improper one.

6.comment: Dahlia: Albedo's Trial and the Durin Crisis
6.content:
During the 5.6 Windblume Festival, Albedo was tried for murder and illegal disposal of human remains. Jean presided in Varka's absence and Dahlia served as assessor for the Church. He weighed the evidence aloud and stressed that a guilty verdict needs sufficient evidence. The trial was in fact a plan to draw out a mimic spawned from the dragon Durin's remains, which had taken Hertha's form. Afterward Dahlia invited the Traveler to Starsnatch Cliff to meet Venti, noting how readily the slightest "difference" is perceived as "other".

During the monster assault, Venti's long-distance wind currents nearly exposed him when Dahlia recognised his whisper. Dahlia stayed with a frightened Sucrose at Rosaria's request. He told her Albedo had shared his origin with close members of his order long ago, and that knowing the truth changed nothing. He is seen in the final cutscene as Durin is reborn.

7.comment: Dahlia: Cardinal Seamus and the Confession
7.content:
When Cardinal Seamus Pegg returned from the Nod-Krai expedition, Dahlia asked to be the first to confess to him. He confessed to "lying" to Barbara by hiding Venti's identity (the Cardinal reminded him Barbatos had permitted the truth), to losing a card game to Venti and buying him three drinks, and to sneaking off with Rosaria for a drink during chores. Penance: copy the Favonian Liturgy three times and the Proverbs six. On Barbara's behalf he asked where Frederica was; the Cardinal did not know. Then the Cardinal asked Dahlia to hear his confession too.

Afterward Dahlia suggested that Barbara used the Cardinal's title instead of "father" because her role as deaconess came first inside the Cathedral. Outside, he said, they could only "let the wind lead". By his birthday in 2026 he was covering some of Seamus's confession duties.

8.comment: Dahlia: Klee and the Surprise Baptism
8.content: Klee found Dahlia practising his "surprise baptism" on a Hydro Slime and was delighted: it could send Jumpy Dumpty flying higher. They spent days bouncing slimes and bombs until they blew up part of the city wall. The guard Lawrence reported them to Jean, who banned using surprise baptism on Jumpy Dumpty. Dahlia calls it "sad times".

9.comment: Dahlia: Choirbook and the Ode to Fine Wine
9.content: Dahlia's hymnbook holds generations-old odes to the Anemo Archon, plus one handwritten score. While drinking with friends, he was asked how a deacon could still drink late; he answered that enjoying the wine Barbatos provides is itself praise. They toasted, and Venti, inspired, played an "Ode to Fine Wine" and gave it to the choir's leader. The sisters refused to add it to the repertoire; Victoria said only Barbatos appearing in person would change her mind. Dahlia then sang it with Venti at Weinlesefest over several days, and it became popular all over the city.

10.content: While searching for a choir member who missed practice, Dahlia found an injured young stranger near Dragonspine and nursed him at the Church for a fortnight. He was a Sumeru researcher whose companions had all been hurt one by one, and he invited Dahlia to join his expeditions. Dahlia, a fan of adventure novels who dreams of leaving for troubles beyond the wind, thought about it for a full day, thanked him in person and declined. He chose his choir, his friends and the people seeking guidance, and resolved to savour the wind on the walls, the bubbles in Dandelion Wine and the people's laughter.

11.comment: Dahlia: Durin's Night at the Tavern
11.content: When the reborn Durin was trying to learn how to make friends, he asked Dahlia (a deacon who listens well) and Kaeya for help. They took him straight to Angel's Share to watch Mondstadters sing and toast. One sniff of the drinks nearly toppled him, and the bartender quietly swapped in juice. Durin concluded this method was beyond him, for now.

12.content: In a limited-time 6.4 event, Alice's memory bubble recreated Mondstadt with discrepancies. When a Tent Tortoise appeared there, Dahlia recalled that almost every Mondstadt child once kept a pet turtle, himself included, and offered to raise it behind the Cathedral with its own pool. Rosaria vetoed the idea as an invasive species waiting to happen.
